description: A note on one firm, signed by the signed-in person and shared with the workspace, up to 2,000 characters. A "[YB] <skill> | <date> | status=<value> | …" line also sets that firm's status line on the user's lists. Meant for the workspace's own research on the firm, not for rows copied from a client's CRM.
name: add_note
title: Add a firm note
